review_status: PROPOSED - every rule awaits agronomy SME signoff at G0; no rule generates a production claim before approval
scoring_model: score = clip(100 + sum(scaled rule deltas), 0, 100); ranking score only, never a probability; blocking rules set score to 0 and exclude the candidate
priority_weighting: factor 0-3 -> weight 0.5+0.5*f applied only to the rule group it names; absent -> 1.0 neutral with an explicit note

rules.applies_to: cereal candidates (wheat, maize) when history[0] is a fabaceae crop
rules.explanation_en: legume predecessor supplies a nitrogen credit and rotation benefit to the following cereal
rules.explanation_ary_pending_review: المزروع البقولي اللي قبل كيعطي أزوت وميزة ديال الدورة للقمح اللي موراه
rules.source: Yigezu et al. 2019 (ICARDA): wheat after faba bean +20-36% vs continuous wheat/barley in Morocco; berseem N credit 33-224 kg N/ha (INRA-Morocco literature)

rules.applies_to: cereal candidates when history[0] is a cereal
rules.explanation_en: cereal after cereal: foliar and soil disease carry-over (septoria, fusarium) - break-crop effect
rules.explanation_ary_pending_review: القمح بعد القمح: خطر أمراض كتبقى فالأرض والبقايا (السيبتوريا والفيوزاريوم)
rules.source: Figueroa et al. 2017 (septoria ~15-20% annual wheat yield losses); GRDC/AHDB break-crop guidance (two-year breaks outperform one)

rules.applies_to: cereal candidates when BOTH history entries are cereals
rules.expression: if crop.family=='poaceae' and prev1 and prev2 both poaceae: -8 (stacks with R-BRK-01)
rules.explanation_en: continuous cereals build up cereal cyst nematodes documented in Moroccan wheat areas
rules.explanation_ary_pending_review: الحبوب وحدة مور وحدة كيكيّفو النيماتود ديال الحبوب اللي موثقين فالمغرب
rules.source: Mokrini et al. 2012 (first report Heterodera latipons, Morocco); Mokrini et al. 2021 (CCN/Pratylenchus status Morocco); Crop Protection Network (CCN worst under lacking rotation)

rules.applies_to: any candidate in the same botanical family as history[0] (except cereal-after-cereal, covered by R-BRK-01)
rules.explanation_en: same botanical family as the previous crop: shared pests and diseases - avoid repeating a family
rules.explanation_ary_pending_review: نفس العائلة النباتية مور مور: نفس الآفات والأمراض كيتقاسمو
rules.source: general plant-health rotation principle; crop-specific cases documented in R-BEET-01 / R-ONI-01

rules.applies_to: sugar_beet when history[0] or history[1] is a beet-family crop (amaranthaceae)
rules.expression: if crop=='sugar_beet' and (prev1 or prev2).family=='amaranthaceae': score=0, excluded (blocking)
rules.explanation_en: sugar beet after a beet-family crop: beet cyst nematode (Heterodera schachtii) - 3-5 year non-host break required
rules.explanation_ary_pending_review: بنجر مور البنجر: النيماتود ديال كيس البنجر - وقفة 3-5 سنوات بلا عائل مضيفة ضرورية
rules.source: Nebraska Extension G1906 (3-5 year rotation); PNW Plant Disease Handbook (3-6 years); non-host crops cut SBCN 40-60%/yr; UC IPM (max 2 beet years in 10)

rules.applies_to: onion when history[0] is an allium-family crop (amaryllidaceae)
rules.explanation_en: onion after allium: white rot (Sclerotium cepivorum) risk - sclerotia survive decades; continuous allium is the highest-risk practice
rules.explanation_ary_pending_review: البصلة مور البصلة: خطر البياض الأبيض - الكليروتس كيعيشو عشرات السنين
rules.source: UC IPM / WSU Hortsense (8-10 year allium-free interval on infested soil); sclerotia longevity documented 20-40 years

rules.applies_to: all candidates; only evaluated when irrigation is known
rules.expression: very_high water class + flood/basin: -8; high + flood/basin: -4; drip/sprinkler/pivot/unknown: 0 (efficiency note, no invented saving)
rules.explanation_en: crop water need vs irrigation system application efficiency (FAO-56 ranges, labeled estimate)
rules.explanation_ary_pending_review: الحاجة المائية ديال المحصول مقارنة بنظام السقي (تقديرات FAO-56)
rules.source: FAO Irrigation & Drainage Paper 56; Tadla surface-irrigation efficiency context (ORMVAT / World Bank studies)

rules.applies_to: all candidates; only evaluated when planned_season is provided
rules.expression: campaign start ~November; frost-sensitive crop outside its window: -10 + warning; window mismatch (low sensitivity): -4; in-window: 0
rules.explanation_en: planting window vs campaign start; Tadla winter minima near 0-5 degC (NASA POWER T2M_MIN, local dataset 1981-2026)
rules.explanation_ary_pending_review: نافذة الزراعة مقارنة ببداية الموسم؛ أدنى درجات الشتاء فتادلة قريبة من 0-5 درجات (بيانات POWER)
rules.source: NASA POWER daily point T2M_MIN (Tadla centroid, 1981-2026, local dataset); FAO EcoCrop windows (approximate, SME review pending)
